skills.summary: Change structure with tests around each edit
skills.job: Change structure while preserving behaviour by running a test or snapshot check before and after every single edit
triggers: refactor this without breaking anything
restructure this module safely
move this logic and prove nothing changed
gotchas: batching many edits between test runs so a failure cannot be traced
refactoring code that has no tests and no characterisation check
mixing a behaviour fix into a structural change

skills.summary: Pull a block of code into its own function
skills.job: Extract a block into a named function with the right parameters and returns while keeping behaviour identical
triggers: extract this into a function
this function is too long, split it
pull this block out into a helper
gotchas: missing a variable the block assigns that later code reads
extracting across an early return or a throw so control flow changes
passing so many parameters that the extraction hides nothing

skills.summary: Rename a symbol everywhere it is used
skills.job: Rename a symbol, file or concept across code, config, docs, tests and serialised names without missing a reference
triggers: rename this function everywhere
change this name across the project
rename this file and fix all imports
gotchas: string references such as config keys and dynamic lookups that search misses
a rename that also changes a persisted or public name
replacing a substring that matches unrelated identifiers

skills.summary: Replace a system piece by piece behind a seam
skills.job: Replace an old component gradually by routing traffic through a seam to the new one, with fallback and a defined end
triggers: migrate off this legacy module gradually
strangler pattern for this service
replace the old implementation without a big bang
gotchas: no deadline so both versions live forever
routing by guesswork instead of a measurable switch
new code that quietly depends on the old one's internals

skills.summary: Plan a major framework version upgrade
skills.job: Plan a major framework or runtime upgrade from the live release notes into ordered, testable steps with a stop point
triggers: plan the upgrade to the next major version
we need to move to the new framework version
what will break if we upgrade this framework
gotchas: trusting a remembered changelog instead of the current migration guide
upgrading the framework and its plugins in one step
no passing baseline before the upgrade starts

skills.summary: Find seams and split a monolith into modules
skills.job: Find the natural boundaries in a large codebase and split it into modules or services in an order that keeps it shipping
triggers: split this monolith
where are the module boundaries here
extract this part into its own service
gotchas: splitting along file layout instead of data ownership
a shared database that keeps the pieces coupled
distributed calls replacing in-process ones with no failure plan

skills.summary: Remove a feature completely and safely
skills.job: Remove a retired feature end to end, including code, data, config, docs and flags, without breaking what remains
triggers: remove this feature entirely
we are sunsetting this, delete the code
clean out the old feature flag and its code
gotchas: deleting code while stored data and migrations still reference it
leaving the flag, docs, translations and tests behind
removing in one commit with no way to revert a piece

skills.summary: Retire an old API with warnings and a date
skills.job: Roll out the deprecation of an interface with a replacement, warnings, a timeline and a measured removal
triggers: deprecate this function
plan removal of the old endpoint
how do we phase out this config option
gotchas: announcing removal without shipping the replacement first
warnings so noisy that users mute them all
removing on the date without checking that usage hit zero

skills.summary: Write a script that rewrites code at scale
skills.job: Write and test a codemod or scripted rewrite that applies a mechanical change across many files and reports what it skipped
triggers: write a codemod for this change
automate this edit across hundreds of files
script the migration of this call pattern
gotchas: regex rewriting where only a syntax-aware tool is safe
running on the whole repo before a single-file dry run
no report of the files the script could not handle

skills.summary: Fill or fix existing data in controlled batches
skills.job: Design and run a backfill that populates or corrects existing records in resumable, verifiable batches
triggers: backfill this new column
fix existing rows after the migration
populate old records with the new field
gotchas: one giant transaction that locks the table
a script that cannot resume after a crash
no count comparison before and after to prove completeness

skills.summary: Write a tested way back before a risky change
skills.job: Define the exact steps, triggers and time limit for undoing a risky change, and prove each step works before shipping
triggers: what is our rollback plan
how do we undo this if it fails
write a rollback for this release
gotchas: rollback that restores code but not the data written by the new version
steps never rehearsed so the first run is the incident
no clear trigger so nobody decides to pull the cord
